behavior_constraints: GET /api/v1/experiments/compare?experiments=...&metric=... returns per-experiment mean/min/max/count, best experiment, and summary with spread, experiment_count, total_runs
CompareExperiments returns 400 if fewer than 2 experiment names are specified or metric parameter is missing
CompareExperiments returns 404 if any named experiment does not exist
CompareExperiments returns 400 with a message containing 'no data' if none of the specified experiments have any runs with the metric
Experiments with no runs having the metric are excluded from the experiments array
POST /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/{num}/annotations creates an annotation with created_at timestamp and returns 409 on duplicate key
Annotation key must be non-empty and contain only letters, digits, underscores; otherwise return 400
GET /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/{num}/annotations returns annotations sorted alphabetically by key with count
DELETE /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/{num}/annotations/{key} returns 200 {"status":"deleted"} or 404 if key missing
All annotation endpoints return 404 if model or version does not exist
affected_prior: GetVersion (must now include annotations field in response)
Version struct/registry internals (must store in-memory annotations)
BatchInfer handler/batch (must update per-request serving statistics, skipping stop_on_error skips)
topologicalSort in pipeline engine (reused for validation execution_order)
AggregateMetric in experiment (likely reused/extended for cross-experiment comparison)
entities.summary: This round adds cross-experiment metric comparison, in-memory model version annotations (with inclusion in get-version responses), pipeline dry-run structural validation, and serving inference statistics tracking with reset.
